title: Swagger API Documentation
goal: Generate interactive OpenAPI 3.0 documentation using Swagger for all API endpoints to enable developer onboarding, testing, and API exploration.

sub_tasks.title: Configure swagger-jsdoc with OpenAPI 3.0
sub_tasks.output: Created swagger.ts with OpenAPI 3.0 spec configuration

sub_tasks.title: Define Security Schemes
sub_tasks.output: Configured BearerAuth (staff JWT), AgentBearerAuth (partner agent JWT), and ApiKeyAuth (external integrations) security schemes

sub_tasks.title: Document Common Schemas
sub_tasks.output: Created reusable schemas for Error, ValidationError, Property, Contact in components

sub_tasks.title: Document API Tags and Paths
sub_tasks.output: Organized endpoints into tags: Auth, Public, Staff Calls, Agent Portal, External, Admin. Documented key paths for login, register, properties, contact, calls, etc.

sub_tasks.title: Mount Swagger UI at /api-docs
sub_tasks.output: Integrated swagger-ui-express middleware, API docs accessible at /api-docs endpoint

acceptance_criteria: All major endpoint categories documented (Auth, Public, Staff Calls, Agent Portal, External)
Security schemes defined for JWT and API Key authentication
Interactive API testing enabled via Swagger UI
API version and contact information included
result_summary: Complete API documentation system using OpenAPI 3.0 and Swagger UI. All major endpoints documented with request/response schemas, authentication requirements, and validation rules. Interactive documentation at /api-docs enables developers to explore and test APIs directly in browser. Three security schemes support different authentication patterns. Organized by tags for easy navigation: Auth, Public, Staff Calls, Agent Portal, External, Admin.
